test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ajay can row his boat in still water, at a speed of 11 km/hr. If the speed of the stream is 7 km/hr, how long will it take to a distance of 54 km downstream?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Downstream Speed** = Speed in Still Water + Speed of Stream

**Downstream Speed** = 11 + 7 = 18 km/hr

**Time Taken** = Distance ÷ Downstream Speed

**Time Taken** = 54 ÷ 18 = 3 hr

**∴ The correct answer is 3 hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of boat in **still water** (u) = 11 km/hr

Speed of **stream** (v) = 7 km/hr

Total **distance** (D) = 54 km

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/407e37110efd636e030f290d51a2d8856a154838ff95684bdc0278168ad94d1f.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Downstream Speed (Sd) = u + v

Time (T) = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sd = 11 + 7

⇒ Sd = 18 km/hr

⇒ Time = 54 ÷ 18

⇒ Time = 3 hr

**∴ The correct answer is 3 hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

Upstream Speed

It is the net speed when a boat moves against the stream. Upstream Speed (Sᵤ) = u − v.

Boat Speed in Still Water

If downstream speed (Sd) and upstream speed (Sᵤ) are known, Boat Speed (u) = (Sd + Sᵤ) ÷ 2.

Speed of the Current

The rate of stream flow can be calculated as: Stream Speed (v) = (Sd − Sᵤ) ÷ 2.</p
